weak_patterns.evidence: Video 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 14 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or literary poetic openings; stick to grounded, conversational real-life observations.
